# Moira

> Ephemeris and Astrology Computation Engine with a native C++17 core, grounded in astronomical precision.

Moira is a sovereign computational engine designed for transparency, auditability, and precision. It implements the full apparent-place reduction pipeline (IAU 2000A/2006, JPL DE-series kernels) with a Python API surface over a native C++17 extension (`_moira_native`), serving as a high-integrity alternative to legacy black-box ephemerides. The published engine has zero required runtime dependencies. An optional FastAPI server (`moira_server`) exposes the engine as typed, versioned REST routes.

## Core Documentation
- [README](README.md): Overview, installation, and quick start.
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Versioned release history (current: 6.1.0).

## Key Modules
- [moira/__init__.py](moira/__init__.py): Main entry point and `Moira` facade class.
- [planets.py](moira/planets.py): Planetary position logic and reduction pipeline.
- [houses.py](moira/houses.py): House cusp calculation for 22 systems.
- [spk_reader.py](moira/spk_reader.py): Native-only JPL SPK kernel access (no third-party fallback).
- [asteroids.py](moira/asteroids.py) / [comets.py](moira/comets.py): Sharded Type-13 small-body catalogs (10,025 asteroids in external release `2026.08.12.1`; 497 numbered periodic comets).
- [primary_directions/](moira/primary_directions/): Placidus, Regiomontanus, and Morinus direction families with direct/converse doctrine.
- [yogas.py](moira/yogas.py): 60 classical yogas across six families as primary-source proof objects.
- [shadbala.py](moira/shadbala.py) / [ashtakavarga.py](moira/ashtakavarga.py): Complete Vedic strength systems including Bhava Bala, kakshya transit, and Shodhya Pinda.
- [harmograms/](moira/harmograms/): Research engine for planetary intensity spectra.
- [heliacal.py](moira/heliacal.py): Generalized celestial visibility and events.
- [moira_server/](moira_server/): Optional FastAPI REST transport layer (60+ route families under `/v1`).

## Principles
- **Truth-First**: Astronomical substrate takes precedence over astrological convenience.
- **Transparency**: Every reduction stage is visible and auditable.
- **Visibility as Doctrine**: AI agents and developers have first-class access to intermediate computational states.
- **Validation**: Benchmarked against IAU standards, JPL SSD, and NASA canon; Vedic engines cite primary sources per rule.
